warning_source: Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan / UAE President
warning_summary: Reported pre-Oct. 7 warning/conversation; original account says MBZ warned that Sinwar was preparing a major operation, while a newly surfaced MBZ-to-Burns account describes a more general warning of a violent Palestinian explosion.
evidence_update: Kan reported on 9 Sep 2026 that MBZ later told senior Israeli/US figures, including then-CIA Director William Burns, that before Oct. 7 he had warned Netanyahu that something was about to explode / of a violent explosion involving Palestinians. This materially strengthens the pro-conversation side but is retrospective and less specific than the original Hamas-operation claim. On 19 Sep 2026 a UAE official source told The National that such security matters are handled through relevant entities, not national leaders; PMO also denies the call and cites call-log checks. Notion WARN-5 upgraded with both sides preserved.
gaps: No transcript, call record, Burns testimony, contemporaneous UAE record or formal inquiry finding. Exact warning date/content remain disputed. Keep WARN-5 Disputed / Medium and do not treat government-level receipt as established.

warning_source: Col. (res.) Doron Hadar reporting messages from Hamas-Israel mediators; former IDF General Staff hostage-negotiation official
recipient: Israeli negotiation/security system; exact senior decision-maker recipients unresolved
warning_summary: Hadar says mediators repeatedly warned before Oct. 7 that continued hostage-negotiation stalemate could lead Yahya Sinwar to attempt a major kidnapping operation or other game-changing move.
evidence_update: Kan first-person interview reported in Sep 2026; Jerusalem Post independently reproduced Hadar's account on 11 Sep 2026. The claim is relevant to Hamas attack/kidnapping risk but remains retrospective and lacks a dated contemporaneous message or identified recipient chain.
gaps: Recover mediator identities, warning dates, original messages/notes, who in Israel received them, whether they reached a serving senior state/security decision-maker, and any contemporaneous response. Do not accept from retrospective testimony alone.

warning_source: Maj. Gen. (res.) Yaakov Amidror / former National Security Council chief and MI Research Division head
recipient: Public audience; named serving decision-maker receipt not established
warning_summary: Amidror warned that war with Iran was becoming increasingly likely, that regional security deterioration was more likely, and that Israel needed to prepare for war even without US assistance.
evidence_update: Contemporaneous 13 Apr 2023 Times of Israel report reproduces Amidror's 103FM interview during the multi-front Passover flare-up. Warning content is directly documented and professionally sourced.
gaps: No evidence found that this specific warning was delivered to or acknowledged by a named serving government or senior state/security decision-maker. Keep as discovery candidate only; regional-war warning, not a Gaza-invasion forecast.
